log.description: Print a value to the console

alert.description: Show a popup in the browser, or a line in the console in Node.js

table.description: Print an array or object as a table

typeof.description: The type of a value: number, string, object, boolean...

int.description: Convert a value to an integer

float.description: Convert a value to a floating-point number

str.description: Convert a value to a string

bool.description: Convert a value to true or false

isNum.description: Check whether a value is a number

isStr.description: Check whether a value is a string

isArr.description: Check whether a value is an array

isObj.description: Check whether a value is an object

max.description: The largest of the given numbers

min.description: The smallest of the given numbers

pow.description: Raise a number to a power

randRange.description: Random integer from from to to, inclusive

sum.description: Sum of the numbers in an array

clamp.description: Constrain a number to a range

trim.description: Remove whitespace from both ends of a string

len.description: Length of a string or array, or the number of keys in an object

split.description: Split a string into an array using a separator

join.description: Join an array into a string using a separator

replace.description: Replace every occurrence of a substring

contains.description: Check whether a substring or element is present

startsWith.description: Check whether a string starts with a substring

endsWith.description: Check whether a string ends with a substring

indexOf.description: Position of a substring or element, or -1 if not found

slice.description: Take part of a string or array

padLeft.description: Pad a string on the left to a given length

padRight.description: Pad a string on the right to a given length

words.description: Split a string into words on whitespace

push.description: Append an element to the end of an array

pop.description: Remove and return the last element of an array

shift.description: Remove and return the first element of an array

unshift.description: Prepend an element to the beginning of an array

filter.description: Keep elements for which the check returns true

map.description: Transform every element of an array with a function

find.description: Find the first element that passes the check

each.description: Run an action for every element

reverse.description: Reverse an array or string (returns a copy)

removeAt.description: Remove an element at a position (returns a copy)

count.description: How many times a value appears in an array

flatten.description: Flatten nested arrays by one level

hasKey.description: Check whether an object has a key

merge.description: Merge two objects into a new one

wait.description: Wait for the given number of milliseconds

writeFile.description: Write text to a file, overwriting it (Node.js only)

appendFile.description: Append text to the end of a file (Node.js only)

exists.description: Check whether a file or folder exists (Node.js only)

listDir.description: List files in a folder (Node.js only)

removeFile.description: Delete a file (Node.js only, use with care!)

httpGet.description: Make a GET request and return the response text

httpJson.description: Make a GET request and return the parsed JSON

httpPost.description: Make a POST request with a body and return the response text

domGet.description: Find an element by CSS selector (browser)

domHtml.description: Set the HTML inside an element (browser)

domStyle.description: Change a CSS property of an element (browser)

domAdd.description: Append HTML to the end of an element (browser)

domValue.description: Read or write an input field's value (browser)

assert.description: Throw an error if a condition is false

tableFrom.description: Turn an array of objects into a table

tableSave.description: Save a table to a JSON file (Node.js only)

tableLoad.description: Load a table from a JSON file (Node.js only)

page.description: Start a page: reset the content and set the tab title

button.description: A button; the second argument is a handler, the third is a Tailwind class list

field.description: An input field; the name is needed to read its value with fieldValue

fieldValue.description: Read what the user entered into the field with this name

list.description: A list: each array element becomes an item

link.description: A link; the third argument is a Tailwind class list

render.description: Render everything built by the page commands (browser)

body.description: A body container; pass Tailwind classes in <>

box.description: A box container; pass Tailwind classes in <>

row.description: A row container; pass Tailwind classes in <>

column.description: A column container; pass Tailwind classes in <>

card.description: A card container; pass Tailwind classes in <>

section.description: A section container; pass Tailwind classes in <>

nav.description: A nav container; pass Tailwind classes in <>

storeGet.description: Read a value from localStorage (JSON), returning the fallback if it is missing

storeSet.description: Save a value to localStorage and return it

storeClear.description: Clear localStorage for the current site

route.description: Register an HTTP route; paths support parameters like /users/:id

respond.description: Respond to the current request; objects are automatically converted to JSON

param.description: A path parameter from a route like /users/:id

requestBody.description: The current request body: a JSON object or a string

header.description: A header of the current request

method.description: The HTTP method of the current request

serverPath.description: The path of the current request

listen.description: Start an HTTP server (Node.js only); used with kuza serve

var.description: Declare a variable. Inside a function or loop, using ":name = ..." again for an existing variable becomes an assignment.

if.description: Condition: "?" means if, "||" means else if / else.

while.description: A loop that repeats while a condition is true.

foreach.description: Iterate over every element of an array.

try.description: Catch an error and handle it.

table.description: Create a table with columns. Add a row with users.add<...>. This is in-memory data, not a SQL database.

select.description: Query a table: choose columns, filter, sort and limit. Columns are read as variables.
select.example:
select name, age from users where age >= 18 order by age desc;
select * from users limit 10;

update.description: Change table rows that match a condition. Values can reference columns: age = age + 1.
update.example: update users set age = 18 where id = 1;

delete.description: Delete table rows that match a condition.

view.description: Reactive Kuza screen: called once and again whenever its variables change.

func.example: func add<a, b> >> [ return a + b; ]

while.description: Loop while a condition is true

return.description: Return a value from a function

select.description: Query a table: columns, where, order by, limit
select.example: :adults = select name, age from users where age >= 18 order by age desc;

update.example: update users set age = 18 where id = 1;

view.description: Screen: a function that draws the page and re-runs when its variables change
